course.title: Humanities 12th - PRARAMBH Pro 2.0 (26-27)
course.description:
PRARAMBH PRO – Class 12th Humanities (Batch 2026–27)

A complete 1-year course to help you prepare for Class 12 Board Exams (2026–27) & CUET UG 2027 with strong concepts and regular practice.


What You Will Get:

  1. Live Interactive Classes of Political Science, History, Geography, Economics, Core Maths/Applied Maths, Entrepreneurship, Sociology, Psychology, Physical Education, English & Hindi for Class 12 Humanities students. 
  2. CUET Batch 2027 Preparation – Along with Boards preparation, you will also get CUET 2027 preparation (Domain Subjects + English + GAT).
  3. For CUET: Both LIVE + Recorded Lectures will be available.

            This will help you prepare for CUET along with your Class 12 Boards.

  1. 2 Classes Daily – Each class will be 1 to 1.5 hours.
  2. Classes According to School Timings – So you can easily manage school and studies.
  3. Weekly Class Schedule will be shared in advance.
  4. Recorded Lectures Available – If you miss any class, you can watch it anytime on the Next Toppers App.
  5. PDF Class Notes will be provided after every class on the Next Toppers App.
  6. Regular Tests – To check your performance and improvement.
  7. Full Course Access till Board Exams & CUET 2027.
  8. Recorded Subjects for Flexible Study – Sociology, Psychology, Physical Education, Entrepreneurship & English/Hindi will be provided in recorded format.
  9. This batch is non-refundable and non-transferable
